issue_title: [Security] TOCTOU race condition in _ensure_parent_directory between path existence check a
fix_summary: Fixed TOCTOU race condition in _ensure_parent_directory by using exist_ok=True in mkdir() call and adding specific error handling for file-as-directory cases.
risks: None identified - minimal change to existing error handling logic
limitations: Concurrent access testing limited to threading; real-world multi-process scenarios may behave differently
